pr_title: Round half cents as the bank does

comments.comment: The change rounds a half cent to the even cent, but docs/design.md still says a half rounds up, and AGENTS.md says to change the document in the same commit.
comments.failureScenario: dollars(0.5) now returns "0.00" and dollars(2.5) returns "0.02", while docs/design.md still says a half rounds up, as Math.round does, which gives "0.01" and "0.03". AGENTS.md says "If you change a behaviour that docs/design.md describes, change the document in the same commit.", so a reader who trusts the design reconciles exports against the wrong rule.
